split_method: sort by SHA-256 of seed:path, then path; first map_fit_count fit maps
image_score: maximum of the equally weighted normalized branch maps
threshold_rule: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))-th smallest independent normal threshold score
guarantee_scope: Rank calculation assumes exchangeable future normal images and a score function fixed independently of threshold samples. These assumptions and production false-alarm performance are not verified.
